description: Labeled answers for measuring the groundedness verifier. Each case has an answer (with [n] citations), the sources it cites (resolved from the corpus by document and section), and whether every claim is supported. 'faithful' answers are paraphrases that must pass; every other fault type must fail. Cases are split into dev (calibration) and test (held out) by position in this file.
